title: Report an excepted estate for Inheritance Tax for deaths from 6 April 2011 to 31 December 2021 (IHT205)
text:
You’ll need to use the print and post form (IHT205) if the person died on or after 6 April 2011, and on or before 31 December 2021, and the estate is unlikely to pay Inheritance Tax.

 If the person died on or before 5 April 2011, you’ll need to report an excepted estate for Inheritance Tax for deaths on or before 5 April 2011 (IHT205) .

 If the person died on or after  1 January 2022, you’ll need to check if you need to send full details of the estate .

 You can check how to value an estate for Inheritance Tax and report its value .

 Report using the print and post form

 You can complete the print and post form as part of the  probate process  if the:

 • deceased’s estate is an ‘excepted estate’ (an estate that does not pay Inheritance Tax and meets other conditions)

 • person that died was a permanent resident of England, Wales or Northern Ireland

 Use the IHT206 notes to get help in filling the form in and find out where to send it.

 How to complete the form

 Before you start

 Make sure your browser is up to date .

 You’ll need to fill in the form fully before you can print it. You cannot save a partly completed form so we suggest you gather all your information together before you begin to fill it in.

 If the form does not open, then contact the online services helpdesk for more help .

 Complete the print and post form

 You need to:

 • 
 Download and save the form on your computer.

 • 
 Open it using the latest free version of Adobe Reader .

 • 
 Complete it on-screen.

 It may not work if you try to open it in your internet browser. If the form does not open, contact the online services helpdesk for more help.
